entries.title: Jeremiah 40:1
segments: The word which came to Jeremiah; these words refer to the prophecies that follow in
, the history of the remnant of the Jews being first given by way of introduction.

entries.title: Jeremiah 40:3
segments: Great and long-continued disobedience in his people, God often punishes in such an exemplary way that even the unconverted are compelled to see and acknowledge his hand.

entries.title: Jeremiah 40:4
segments: When the visible church of God hates and persecutes his messengers, he often raises up for them defenders from without, under whose protection they are enabled to prosecute their labors in safety.

entries.title: Jeremiah 40:5
segments: While he was not yet gone back; the prophet seems to have hesitated respecting his future course, which gave occasion to Nebuzar-adan to put his proposition in a different form.

entries.title: Jeremiah 40:7
segments: Captains of the forces; leaders, of the scattered bands of the Jews.

entries.title: Jeremiah 40:8
segments: Mizpah; in the land of Benjamin, a short distance north-west from Jerusalem.

entries.title: Jeremiah 40:13
segments:
vv 13-16. 
 
Those who are conscious of their own integrity, are sometimes too unsuspecting with regard to their fellow men, and thus, by neglecting the warnings of friends, become involved, with those under their care, in calamity and death.
